fields.System.Title: FDN-203 — Seed a demo warehouse
fields.System.Description:
Story

As a developer, I want a realistic warehouse to exist after a fresh start, so that
every later feature can be developed and demonstrated against real-looking data.

Acceptance criteria

  • - Given a fresh database, when the seed runs, then one warehouse, five zones, five
  • virtual locations, about forty locations, and about thirty products exist.
  • - Given the seed, then it includes deliberately awkward cases: a product with no
  • barcode, a product with three barcodes, a batch-tracked product with two batches (one
  • expiring soon), a location at exactly maximum capacity, and a blocked location holding stock.
  • - Given the seed, then opening stock is created as receipts with movements, not by
  • inserting balances directly.
  • - Given the seed runs twice, then it does not duplicate data.
  • - Given the seed, then no automated test depends on it.

Traceability

| Aspect | Detail |
|---|---|
| Modules | masterdata, inventory |
| Tables | all master data, stock_balance, stock_movement |
| Risks | Clean seed data hides defects ([doc 10 §6](../../../docs/10-local-deployment.md)); balances without movements break reconciliation ([doc 09 §11.3](../../../docs/09-defect-hotspots.md)) |
| Tests | integration |
